sports.title: Rajasthan stuck in 2012, Manipur in 2023: How actively are states with CWG medals promoting sports?
sports.body: India’s states celebrated 39 Commonwealth Games medals, but how much are their sports departments actually promoting those achievements? This investigation tracks the social-media activity of state sports bodies, revealing glaring gaps, from Rajasthan’s last Facebook post in 2012 and Manipur’s silence to Haryana’s limited outreach. In contrast, states like Tamil Nadu show how one can promote grassroots athletes consistently on social media.
